sourceReview.method: Verified static .data buffer limits in signed ggml-hexagon.dll (m-size = 0x20000000 = 512 MiB, v-size = 3000 MiB on v81, h-size = 1024 MiB) and 4 MiB VTCM acquisition in libggml-htp-v81.so; expanded NativeQ2ProjectionLimits to K<=17408, M<=17408, 4 MiB VTCM (for K>6144 such as ffn_down [17408, 5120]), and 256 MiB resident weight arena (NATIVE_Q2_MAX_RESIDENT_WEIGHT_BYTES); added RowParallelism::update_chunks to parallelize host PQ2_0->HTP_TYPE_Q2_0 tile packing across 4 row workers; and admitted all 10 PQ2_0 layer projection types across recurrent and full-attention layers.
sourceReview.scope: RowParallelism::update_chunks in prism-inference, full-layer K<=17408 / 256 MiB resident arena / 4 MiB VTCM in hexagon-native-rpc, parallelized packing and 1-op direct output in NativeQ2Executor (bonsai-hexagon-runtime), multi-layer admission in prism-hexagon-model-probe, and matching verification in bonsai-tools model_device.

diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.power: Outer workload clock and all control arms observed battery operation (acConnected: false, batterySaver: false, 90% battery charge) throughout the 32.971-second run (within the 300-second predeclared allowance; 60.658 seconds cumulative including the closed 27.687-second diagnostic at 8a7980a). Because the controls ran on battery power rather than AC power, evaluation wall-clock comparisons are retained as diagnostic observations only and are not qualified as performance comparisons.
diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.interpretation: Expanding NativeQ2ProjectionLimits to K<=17408 (with 4 MiB VTCM for K>6144 projections such as ffn_down [17408, 5120] where n_prefetch=4 uses 2,949,376 bytes VTCM) and 256 MiB resident arena capacity (within ggml-hexagon.dlls 512 MiB m-size single-buffer limit) enabled offloading all 6 PQ2_0 projections of a recurrent layer (blk.0, 107,642,880 bytes) and all 13 PQ2_0 projections of both a recurrent layer and a full-attention layer (blk.0 + blk.3, 212,336,640 bytes) in 1-op full-K HVX execution. Parallelizing host PQ2_0->HTP_TYPE_Q2_0 tile packing across 4 row workers via RowParallelism::update_chunks kept Token-0 cold preparation + execution at 603.33 ms for 6 projections (107.64 MB packed) and 496.00 ms for 13 projections (212.34 MB packed). Total NPU submit-and-wait latency was 2.2704-2.8738 ms across all 6 projections of blk.0 (~0.378 ms per projection) and 4.3826-5.4553 ms across all 13 projections of blk.0 + blk.3 (~0.337-0.420 ms per projection). Across all 248,320 vocabulary logits on tokens 42, 43, and 128, 13-projection NPU execution matched CPU control with cosine similarity 0.999902-0.999977, RMSE 0.0228-0.0290, exact top-1 token agreement (1183, 12, 248), and 5/5 top-5 overlap.

defaultBlockers: The published CPU Prism runtime and server have no NPU serving integration. Changing the descriptive admission lock alone cannot enable offload.

The experimental session uses a single FastRPC rpcmem buffer (capped by ggml-hexagon.dll m-size = 512 MiB; currently admitted up to 256 MiB resident weights + 24 MiB working buffer = 280 MiB). Holding all 64 layers (~6.7 GB packed Q2_0) resident across the full model requires multi-buffer FastRPC arena management (up to the 3000 MiB v81 CDSP virtual address space limit) or layer-group staging.

Each projection currently uses a separate 1-op dspqueue write/read round-trip (~0.34-0.38 ms per projection); chaining multiple operations per dspqueue packet (e.g., ffn_up + ffn_gate + SwiGLU + ffn_down with VTCM intermediate residency) will further reduce FastRPC wakeup overhead.
Controls in this session ran on battery power (acConnected: false, 90% charge); AC-powered comparison controls are required for qualified performance claims.
nextConcreteImplementation: Implement multi-buffer resident weight arena allocation across multiple rpcmem FDs (within ggml-hexagon.dlls 512 MiB per-buffer m-size and 3000 MiB v81 v-size limits) and multi-op dspqueue packet chaining (e.g., full FFN block ffn_up + ffn_gate + SwiGLU + ffn_down in a single queue submission).
